blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Scaling depth is a key route to stronger large language models, but Pre-LN architectures often suffer from depth-wise information dilution, limiting the effective use of deep layers. While cross-layer connectivity has proven effective at mitigating this problem, existing designs usually introduce additional computation or memory access. We revisit cross-layer KV sharing as an efficient form of such connectivity. Beyond cache compression, each KV reuse edge creates a direct gradient path from deep layers to source KV projections, turning KV sharing into an implicit structural regularizer for KV representation geometry. We provide a systematic analysis of this mechanism, showing that proper sharing topologies sharpen key retrieval directions while enriching the value content subspace, whereas existing adjacent or global-anchor designs do not fully exploit this effect. Motivated by this, we propose DepthGraft, a hierarchical KV-sharing architecture that reconstructs deep-layer KV from stride-aligned shallow-middle source pairs. DepthGraft distributes non-local gradient flow across source layers, while preserving prefill early completion and reducing KV cache by roughly one third. Experiments on dense and MoE models from 0.5B to 16B parameters show consistent downstream improvements under both GQA and MLA. Notably, on the 16B MoE model, DepthGraft achieves a 7.0% absolute improvement on MMLU-Pro, along with gains of 6.6% on CMMLU and 6.4% on C3. These results validate the potential of DepthGraft as a scalable design for large-scale pretraining. The project page is available at https://github.com/jianke0604/DepthGraft.
blocks.zh: 放大深度是更强大的大语言模型的关键途径,但前LN架构往往会受深度信息稀释的影响,限制了深层的有效利用. 虽然跨层连通性已被证明能有效缓解这个问题,但现有的设计通常会引入额外的计算或内存访问. 我们重新审视跨层KV共享作为这种连接的有效形式. 除了缓存压缩外,每个KV再利用边缘都会产生从深层到源KV预测的直接梯度路径,将KV共享转化为KV表达几何的隐含结构常态. 我们对这一机制进行了系统分析,表明适当的共享地形会突出关键检索方向,同时丰富价值内容子空间,而现有的相邻或全局锁定设计并没有充分利用这种效果。 以此为动力,我们提出"深度分流"(DepthGraft),一种分级的KV共享架构,从相通相通的浅中源对重建出深层KV. DepthGraft在源地层间分布出非局部梯度流,同时保留了预填提前完成并减少大约三分之一的KV缓存. 关于从0.5B到16B参数的密度模型和MOE模型的实验表明,在GQA和MLA下游都有一致的改进. 值得注意的是,在16B MOE模式中,深度分层在MMLU-Pro上实现了7.0%的绝对改善,同时CMMLU的增益为6.6%,C3的增益为6.4%. 这些结果验证了深度外观作为大规模预训可扩展设计的潜力. 项目网页见https://github.com/jianke0604/ DepthGraft。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Scaling depth has been a primary lever for improving Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) [ 42 , 32 , 21 ] .
In modern Pre-Layer-Normalization Transformers [ 40 ] , however, adding layers does not always yield the expected improvements [ 11 , 22 ] .
The residual stream [ 12 ] aggregates all preceding computations through a single hidden-state trajectory with fixed additive updates; as the stack grows deeper, features formed in early layers can be progressively diluted and become difficult for later layers to retrieve.
This depth-wise information dilution limits the effective use of additional layers, making depth scaling less efficient than its representational capacity would suggest [ 30 , 9 ] .
blocks.zh:
扩展深度一直是改进以变形器为基础的大语言模型[42、32、21]的主要杠杆。
然而,在现代的"前Layer-Normalization变形器"[40]中,加层并不总是产生预期的改进[11,22].
残流[12]通过一个有固定添加剂更新的单一隐藏状态轨迹来汇总之前的所有计算;随着堆积的加深,早期地层所形成的特征会被逐渐稀释并变得后层难以取回.
这种深度信息稀释限制了额外地层的有效利用,使深度缩放的效率低于其代表能力所显示的[30,9].

blocks.en:
Recent work has validated cross-layer connectivity as an effective remedy for information dilution along depth.
Instead of forcing all depth history through the residual stream, recent designs allow deep layers to directly read earlier representations: Attention Residuals [ 33 ] reweights preceding hidden states to replace fixed residual accumulation, while Mixture-of-Depths Attention (MoDA) [ 48 ] augments attention with key–value pairs from previous layers.
Such connections give deep layers direct access to earlier features and create shorter gradient paths to shallow layers.
However, dense cross-layer access also introduces additional computation, memory traffic, and system complexity, requiring careful performance–efficiency trade-offs and sophisticated systems-level engineering.
blocks.zh:
最近的工作证明,跨层互联互通是信息沿着深度稀释的有效补救办法。
近期的设计不但没有强迫所有深度历史通过残留流,反而允许深层直接阅读更早的表示: 注意残余 [33] 在隐藏状态之前重新加权,以取代固定的残余积累,而Mixture-of-Dephs 注意 (MoDA) [48] 用以前各层的键-值对来增加注意.
这种连接使深层直接进入更早的地物,并产生更短的梯度路径到浅层.
然而,密集的跨层访问也带来了额外的计算、内存流量和系统复杂性,需要谨慎的性能-效率取舍和复杂的系统层面工程。

blocks.en:
We note that cross-layer KV sharing can also be viewed as a form of such connectivity:
it provides deep layers with a channel that bypasses information dilution in the residual stream by granting direct access to shallow-layer memory representations,
while gradients flow from deep layers back through the shared KV to shallow layers,
supplying shallow-layer KV with optimization signals driven by deep-layer task demands—thus holding the potential to improve depth utilization.
Although cross-layer KV sharing has been explored in prior work [ 4 , 49 , 31 ] , existing methods predominantly approach it from the perspective of cache compression and inference acceleration.
No prior work has systematically studied the cross-layer gradient dynamics of KV sharing, especially how such connections reshape KV representation geometry during pretraining and how the sharing topology determines this effect.
blocks.zh:
我们注意到,跨层的KV共享也可视为这种互联互通的一种形式:
它为深层提供了一个通道,通过允许直接访问浅层内存表达来绕过剩余流中的信息稀释,
梯度从深层回流到浅层
向浅层KV提供由深层任务需求驱动的优化信号,从而有可能提高深度利用。
虽然在前作[4,49,31]中探索了跨层KV共享,但现有方法主要从缓存压缩和推论加速的角度来进行.
前作没有系统地研究过KV共享的跨层梯度动态,特别是这种连接如何在预训期间重塑KV代表几何,以及共享地理学如何决定这种效果.

blocks.en:
In this paper, we propose that KV sharing is not merely a cache-saving mechanism, but also a form of cross-layer gradient regularization .
When a source layer’s KV is reused by a distant deep layer, the source KV receives training signals from multiple query spaces.
This reshapes KV representation geometry in an asymmetric way: keys are encouraged to concentrate around shared discriminative retrieval directions, while values are pushed to cover a richer content subspace.
With a proper sharing topology, this specialization sharpens memory retrieval while increasing the expressive capacity of the value content channel, yielding a useful structural bias for training.
We use this lens to revisit existing KV-sharing methods and find that their topologies expose complementary limitations.
Adjacent-layer sharing provides too little query-space separation, whereas global-anchor sharing concentrates heterogeneous deep-layer gradients on a few sources, preventing either design from fully exploiting the regularization effect.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们提出,KV共享不仅仅是缓存储蓄机制,而且也是一种跨层梯度规范化的形式.
当一个源层的KV被一个遥远的深层再用时,源KV会从多个查询空间接收训练信号.
这以不对称的方式重塑了KV代表几何:鼓励密钥围绕共享的歧义检索方向来集中,而数值被推向覆盖更丰富的内容子空间.
有了适当的共享地貌,这种专业化会加强内存检索,同时会提高价值内容通道的表达能力,从而产生有用的培训结构偏好.
我们用这个镜头来重新审视现有的KV共享方法,发现它们的地貌暴露出互补的局限性.
相邻层共享提供的查询-空间分隔太少,而全球锁定共享则将不同的深层梯度集中在几个来源上,使这两种设计都无法充分利用规范化效应。

blocks.en:
Motivated by this analysis, we propose DepthGraft , a simple hierarchical KV-sharing design derived from the cross-layer regularization view.
DepthGraft partitions the network into shallow, middle, and deep stages.
The shallow and middle stages compute KV normally, while each deep layer reconstructs its KV from a stride-aligned shallow–middle source pair using learnable channel-wise coefficients.
This construction creates non-local source–reuse connections with sufficient query-space separation, distributes cross-layer gradients across many source layers rather than a few global anchors, and gives each deep layer access to memory bases at two abstraction levels.
As a result, DepthGraft preserves the efficiency benefits of KV sharing, including prefill early completion and KV-cache reduction, while turning the memory pathway into an effective regularized cross-layer connection.
Training-dynamics analyses further support our theory, showing that DepthGraft reshapes KV representation geometry as predicted, and experiments across dense and MoE models demonstrate consistent performance gains at multiple scales.
blocks.zh:
基于这一分析,我们提议采用从跨层规范化观点衍生出来的简单的分级KV共享设计.
深度分出网络分为浅分,中分相和深分相.
浅相和中相通常会计算出KV,而每个深相层则会用可学习的通道系数从一个相向的浅相-中相源对中重建出它的KV.
这种构造创建了非本地源- 重复使用连接, 并有足够的查询- 空间分隔, 将跨层梯度分布在许多源层上而不是几个全局锚地上, 并让每个深层在两个抽象级别上访问内存基.
因此,"深度Graft"保留了KV共享的效率效益,包括预填提前完成和KV-cache还原,同时将内存路径转变为有效的正统跨层连接.
训练-动力学分析进一步支持了我们的理论,表明深度Graft重塑了预测的KV代表几何,并跨稠密和MOE模型的实验显示在多尺度上一致的性能收益.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are as follows.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下。

blocks.en:
1). KV sharing as cross-layer gradient regularization. We identify KV sharing as a form of cross-layer connectivity and provide a systematic analysis of how its gradient paths reshape KV geometry.
Our analysis shows that proper KV sharing sharpens key retrieval directions while enriching the value content subspace, and that this effect is governed by the sharing topology.
blocks.zh:
1).一. KV 共享作为跨层梯度规范化. 我们确定KV共享是跨层连接的一种形式,并系统分析其梯度路径如何重塑KV几何.
我们的分析显示,适当的KV共享在丰富价值内容子空间的同时会突出关键检索方向,这种效果受共享地貌的支配.

blocks.en:
2). Hierarchical cross-layer KV reconstruction. We propose DepthGraft, which uses a hierarchical stage layout to reconstruct deep-layer KV from stride-aligned shallow–middle source pairs.
This yields a distributed non-local connectivity pattern with two abstraction-level memory bases, avoiding the concentrated-anchor structure of prior KV-sharing methods.
blocks.zh:
2 (中文(简体) ). 分级跨层KV重建. 我们提议采用分级阶段布局的深度地平线,
这产生了分布式的非局部连接模式,有两个抽象级的内存基础,避免了之前KV共享方法的集中-锁定结构.

blocks.en:
3). Efficient and scalable implementation. DepthGraft removes independent KV materialization from the deep stage, reducing KV cache by roughly 1 3 \frac{1}{3} and allowing KV construction to finish before the final stage during prefill.
Its stride-aligned source assignment is engineering-friendly and naturally compatible with PP/VPP schedules, making the design suitable for large-scale distributed training.
blocks.zh:
第3条。 有效和可扩展的执行。 DepthGraft从深层阶段移除了独立的KV物质化,将KV缓存减少大约 1 3\frac{1}} 并允许KV 构造在预填阶段的最后阶段之前完成.
它的步调相通源任务对工程友好并自然与PP/VPP时间表相兼容,使得设计适合大规模分布式训练.

blocks.en:
4). Consistent empirical gains. We validate DepthGraft on both dense and MoE models, covering model scales from 0.5B to 16B total parameters.
Across scales and attention variants, DepthGraft consistently improves downstream performance while preserving inference efficiency.
blocks.zh:
(原始内容存档于2018-09-25) (中文(简体) ). 4, C. 持续的经验成果。 我们在密度模型和MOE模型上都验证了"深度"(DepthGraft),涵盖模型尺度从0.5B到16B的总参数.
纵观尺度和注意力变体,深度分流在保持推论效率的同时,不断提高下游的性能.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Cross-layer connectivity. A broad line of work enriches depth-wise information flow by giving each layer direct access to earlier representations [ 15 , 17 , 18 ] .
DenseNet [ 15 ] concatenates all preceding feature maps, establishing a canonical dense cross-layer design.
In Transformers, DenseFormer [ 23 ] and ANCRe [ 45 ] introduce learned layer-wise connection weights, while Value Residual Learning [ 47 ] adds targeted residual access to earlier value states.
Attention Residuals [ 33 ] replaces fixed residual accumulation with learned reweighting over preceding hidden states, and MoDA [ 48 ] augments sequence attention with key–value memories from previous layers.
Together, these works show that cross-layer connectivity is an effective mechanism for improving deep Transformer architectures [ 44 , 25 ] .
blocks.zh:
跨层连通. 广泛的工作范围使每一层都能直接查阅先前的陈述[15、17、18],从而丰富了深度信息流动。
DenseNet [15] 整理了所有前作的地物图,建立了犬形密集的跨层设计.
在"变形器"中,DenseFormer [23]和ANCRE [45] 引入了有学问的分层连接权重,而"价值剩余学习"[47]则增加了对更早的值态的定向剩余访问.
注意后遗症[33] 将固定的后遗症累积替换为对先前隐藏状态的再加权,而MODA[48] 将序列关注与前几层的关键-价值记忆相加。
这些作品一起表明,跨层互联互通是改进深层变形器架构[44,25]的有效机制.

blocks.en:
KV sharing for efficient inference. KV cache is a major memory bottleneck during autoregressive inference, motivating many methods that reduce cache storage through KV sharing [ 38 , 43 , 37 ] .
Cross-layer KV sharing is an important direction in this line.
CLA [ 4 ] and MLKV [ 49 ] reuse KV within adjacent layer groups, reducing cache but often incurring performance degradation when the reuse constraint becomes too strong.
YOCO [ 31 ] shares a global KV memory for all deeper layers, enabling prefill early completion and strong cache reduction.
FusedKV [ 20 ] further reconstructs deep-layer KV from two global anchors, providing more flexibility than direct global reuse.
Cross-layer KV sharing is becoming an increasingly important architectural choice for large-scale LLM pretraining, as illustrated by its adoption in DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash [ 41 ] and HySparse2 [ 35 ] .
blocks.zh:
KV共享高效推论. KV缓存是自回推论中的一个主要内存瓶颈,激发出许多通过KV共享减少缓存存储的方法[38,43,37].
跨层KV共享是本行的重要方向.
CLA [4]和MLKV [49]在相邻地层组内再利用KV,减少缓存,但当再利用约束变得过强时,经常会发生性能退化.
YOCO [31] 共享所有更深层的全球KV内存,使预填提前完成和强大的缓存减少成为可能.
FusedKV [20] 从两个全球锚地上进一步重建了深层KV,提供了比直接全球再利用更大的灵活性.
跨层的KV共享正在成为大规模LLM预训的日益重要的建筑选择,其通过在DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash [41]和HySparse2 [35].

blocks.en:
Positioning. DepthGraft systematically analyzes how cross-layer KV sharing alters training dynamics, showing that the induced cross-layer gradients can regularize KV representation geometry.
Guided by this analysis, DepthGraft uses stride-aligned hierarchical reconstruction to improve KV representations and model quality while preserving the KV-cache savings of sharing-based inference.
blocks.zh:
准备 DepthGraft系统分析跨层KV共享如何改变训练动态,显示被诱导的跨层梯度可以使KV表达几何规范化.
以这一分析为取向,深度分层法使用步态分层重建来提高KV的表示和模型质量,同时保留了基于共享推论的KV缓存.

Cross-layer KV sharing as memory routing. KV sharing replaces some of these independent KV tensors with KV tensors produced at other layers.
We write ( 𝐊 ℓ use , 𝐕 ℓ use ) (\mathbf{K}_{\ell}^{\mathrm{use}},\mathbf{V}_{\ell}^{\mathrm{use}}) for the pair actually used by layer ℓ \ell in Eq. 2 .

Thus a KV-sharing scheme specifies a cross-layer memory-routing graph: source layers produce memory states, and reuse layers consume them.
This view separates three design choices that matter for both efficiency and optimization: which layers serve as sources, how many reuse layers each source serves, and how the reused KV is constructed.

KV sharing amplifies K/V specialization through cross-layer gradients. Consider a source layer s s whose KV is reused by a distant layer ℓ \ell .
The source KV receives both its local gradient and the reuse-layer gradient: ∇ 𝐊 s share = 1 d ​ 𝐆 s ⊤ ​ 𝐐 s + 1 d ​ 𝐆 ℓ ⊤ ​ 𝐐 ℓ , ∇ 𝐕 s share = 𝐏 s ⊤ ​ 𝐄 s + 𝐏 ℓ ⊤ ​ 𝐄 ℓ . \nabla_{\mathbf{K}_{s}}^{\mathrm{share}}=\tfrac{1}{\sqrt{d}}\,\mathbf{G}_{s}^{\top}\mathbf{Q}_{s}+\tfrac{1}{\sqrt{d}}\,\mathbf{G}_{\ell}^{\top}\mathbf{Q}_{\ell},\qquad\nabla_{\mathbf{V}_{s}}^{\mathrm{share}}=\mathbf{P}_{s}^{\top}\mathbf{E}_{s}+\mathbf{P}_{\ell}^{\top}\mathbf{E}_{\ell}. (7) The same source key now serves two query spaces, and the same source value supports two readout patterns.
When s s and ℓ \ell are sufficiently separated, 𝐐 s \mathbf{Q}_{s} and 𝐐 ℓ \mathbf{Q}_{\ell} share task-relevant retrieval directions but also contain layer-specific components.
For keys, shared discriminative directions receive coherent reinforcement, whereas layer-specific directions can interfere through the softmax competition; the source key is therefore biased toward directions useful across both layers, further sharpening the retrieval geometry.
For values, the two readout terms do not compete through softmax.

blocks.en:
Our analysis suggests that cross-layer gradients can act as a structural regularizer for KV geometry, but the regularization effect is determined by the topology of the sharing graph.
We now revisit existing KV-sharing designs and show that they expose complementary limitations.

Only the anchor layers receive direct cross-layer KV gradients from deep layers; the remaining shallow and middle layers may still receive gradients through the residual stream, but they do not participate in the direct KV-sharing path analyzed in Sec. 3.2 .
Fig. 5 in the appendix illustrates this effect for FusedKV: the anchor layer exhibits elevated V effective rank, whereas nearby non-anchor layers show no clear improvement over the baseline.

blocks.en: 3.4 DepthGraft: Hierarchical Cross-Layer KV Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 3.4 深度 格拉夫特:分级跨拉耶克V 重建

blocks.en: By viewing KV-sharing designs through the lens of cross-layer gradients as structural regularization, the analysis above motivates the following design principles:
blocks.zh: 通过通过跨层梯度的透镜来看待KV共享设计作为结构正统化,上述分析激励了以下设计原则: 1.

blocks.en: 1. Sufficient cross-layer distance. Source and reuse layers must be separated by enough depth that their query spaces meaningfully diverge, enabling the gradient interference that drives K/V specialization. Adjacent-layer sharing fails this condition.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 有足够的跨层距离。 源层和再利用层必须用足够的深度分开,使其查询空间发生有意义的差异,从而能够产生推动K/V专业化的梯度干扰。 相邻层共享失败此条件 。

blocks.en: 2. Distributed gradient flow with full-layer participation. Each source layer should receive gradients from only a small number of reuse layers to avoid gradient congestion, and most layers should participate in the cross-layer connectivity graph so that the regularization benefit is not confined to a few anchors.
blocks.zh: 2. 联合国 分布式梯度流有全层参与. 每个源层应当从少数再利用层得到梯度来避免梯度拥堵,而大多数层应当参与跨层连接图,这样规范化的好处就不限于几个锚.

blocks.en:
We instantiate these requirements under an efficiency constraint: all source KV tensors should be produced before the reconstructed layers, preserving prefill early completion.
Based on this, we propose DepthGraft, which introduces a hierarchical stage layout that partitions the L L -layer Transformer into shallow, middle, and deep stages, each containing roughly L / 3 L/3 layers.
The shallow and middle stages compute KV normally, while the deep stage reconstructs its KV from earlier stages.
Rather than using global anchors, DepthGraft adopts stride-aligned source assignment , treating deep-layer memory as a locally reconstructed trajectory over depth.
For each deep layer ℓ \ell , DepthGraft selects one shallow source and one middle source at the same relative depth position: s ⁡ ( ℓ ) = ℓ − 2 ​ L 3 , m ⁡ ( ℓ ) = ℓ − L 3 . s(\ell)=\ell-\tfrac{2L}{3},\qquad m(\ell)=\ell-\tfrac{L}{3}. (10)

This gives each deep layer two memory bases at different abstraction levels: shallow memory preserves lower-level lexical and token-local patterns, while middle-layer memory carries more abstract semantic states [ 2 , 46 , 26 ] .
It then reconstructs KV from the corresponding shallow–middle source pair with learnable per-dimension coefficients: 𝐊 ℓ = 𝐚 ℓ , 1 ⊙ 𝐊 s ⁡ ( ℓ ) + 𝐚 ℓ , 2 ⊙ 𝐊 m ⁡ ( ℓ ) , 𝐕 ℓ = 𝐛 ℓ , 1 ⊙ 𝐕 s ⁡ ( ℓ ) + 𝐛 ℓ , 2 ⊙ 𝐕 m ⁡ ( ℓ ) , \mathbf{K}_{\ell}=\mathbf{a}_{\ell,1}\odot\mathbf{K}_{s(\ell)}+\mathbf{a}_{\ell,2}\odot\mathbf{K}_{m(\ell)},\qquad\mathbf{V}_{\ell}=\mathbf{b}_{\ell,1}\odot\mathbf{V}_{s(\ell)}+\mathbf{b}_{\ell,2}\odot\mathbf{V}_{m(\ell)}, (11) where 𝐚 ℓ , i , 𝐛 ℓ , i \mathbf{a}_{\ell,i},\mathbf{b}_{\ell,i} are channel-wise coefficients for each KV group, providing higher flexibility and expressiveness than single-source reuse.

blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
Training Settings. We conduct experiments on both dense and sparse MoE language models.
For MoE models, we evaluate three scales of DeepSeekMoE-style Transformers [ 10 ] with SwiGLU feed-forward networks, ranging from 3B to 16B total parameters.
For dense models, we train models from 0.5B to 1.5B parameters.
The main comparisons use models trained from scratch with matched data and training recipes at each scale.
Training details are provided in Appendix A , and additional experiments are provided in Appendix D .

培训设置。 我们用密度和稀少的教育部语言模型进行实验。
对于MOE模型,我们用SwiGLU的feed-forward网络来评价DeepSeekMoE-style Transformers[10]的三个尺度,总参数从3B到16B不等.
对于稠密的模型,我们训练模型从0.5B到1.5B参数.
主要比较采用从零开始训练的模型,每个尺度都有匹配的数据和培训配方。

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
Dense models. We first evaluate DepthGraft on dense Transformers at 0.5B, 1B, and 1.5B parameters (Table 1 ).
DepthGraft improves the average score at all three scales, by +0.75, +0.85, and +2.42 points, respectively.
The gains are not confined to a single benchmark family.
At 1.5B, for example, DepthGraft improves knowledge understanding (MMLU +3.33, MMLU-Pro +1.43), reasoning and mathematics (SIQA +2.86, GSM8K +0.91), code generation (MBPP +5.20), and Chinese comprehension (C3 +9.46).
This consistent improvement on dense models indicates that constraining only the KV memory pathway does not reduce model capacity; instead, it provides a useful inductive bias for deep-layer memory representations.
blocks.zh:
情侣模特 我们首先以0.5B、1B和1.5B参数(表1)对密集变压器进行深度评价。
深度分法提高所有三个尺度的平均分数,分别提高+0.75分,+0.85分和+2.42分.
收益不仅限于一个基准家庭。
例如,在1.5B时,深度分解提高了知识理解(MMLU+3.3,MMLU-Pro+1.43),推理和数学(SIQA+2.86,GSM8K+0.91),代码生成(MBP+5.20)和中文理解(C3+9.46).
这种对密集模型的一贯改进表明,只限制KV内存路径并不能降低模型容量;相反,它为深层内存表达提供了有益的诱导偏差.

blocks.en:
MoE models. We next scale DepthGraft to MoE architectures from 3B to 16B total parameters (Table 2 ).
Across GQA-based MoE models, DepthGraft consistently outperforms the corresponding baseline, improving the average score by +1.05, +2.29, and +3.61 points at 3B, 9B, and 16B, respectively.
The 16B model shows especially strong gains, including MMLU-Pro (+7.00), CMMLU (+6.61), C3 (+6.41), and GSM8K (+5.84).
Furthermore, the consistent gains on both 9B GQA (+2.29 Avg.) and 9B MLA (+3.68 Avg.) further show that DepthGraft is not tied to a particular attention implementation.
blocks.zh:
教育部的模型。 接下来,我们将深度调整到 3B 至 16B 总参数(表2 ) 。
纵观基于GQA的MOE模型,深度Graft始终超越了相应的基线,将3B,9B和16B的平均得分分别提高+1.05,+2.29和+3.61分.
16B模式显示出特别显著的收益,包括MMLU-Pro(+7.00),CMMLU(+6.61),C3(+6.41)和GSM8K(+5.84).
此外,在9B GQA(+2.29 Avg.)和9B MLA(+3.68 Avg.)上取得的一致进展进一步表明,深度分析与特别关注的执行无关。

blocks.en:
Taken together, the main results support the mechanism developed in Sec. 3.2 : cross-layer KV reconstruction improves performance not merely by saving cache, but by reshaping the geometry of KV representations through direct cross-layer gradient regularization.
The fact that the gains appear across dense models, sparse MoE models, different attention variants, and a wide range of scales suggests that the effect is a stable architectural bias rather than a scale-specific artifact.
During training, we also observe that the cross-layer gradient regularization introduced by DepthGraft can weaken attention-sink behavior, further supporting the view that DepthGraft improves the organization of the memory pathway.
Detailed visualization and analysis are provided in Appendix E.2 .
blocks.zh:
综合起来,主要结果支持在Sec.3.2中发展出的机制:跨层的KV重建不仅通过保存缓存,而且通过直接跨层梯度规范化来重塑KV表示的几何功能来提高性能.
收益出现在密集的模型,稀有的MOE模型,不同的关注变体,以及广泛的尺度上,这说明这种效果是稳定的建筑偏差,而不是规模特有文物.
在训练期间,我们还观察到由"深度分泌"引入的跨层梯度规范化会削弱注意-沉积行为,进一步支持"深度分泌"改善内存路径组织的观点.
附录E.2提供了详细的可视化和分析。

blocks.en:
Efficiency Analysis. As discussed in Sec. 3.4 , DepthGraft does not materialize independent KV tensors in the deep stage, yielding a fixed KV-cache reduction of roughly one third.
Table 3 further reports end-to-end TTFT and TPOT on 9B MLA and 16B GQA models with a fixed 2K generation length.
DepthGraft substantially reduces TTFT, and the gain becomes larger at longer contexts where prefill is increasingly compute-bound.
At 128K context length, TTFT is reduced by 26.8% on 9B MLA and 28.8% on 16B GQA.
In contrast, TPOT is nearly unchanged: the overhead remains below 1% across all tested context lengths.
This suggests that DepthGraft preserves decoding efficiency while substantially reducing prefill latency, and the gap to the theoretical speedup can be further reduced with specialized kernel optimizations.
blocks.zh:
效率分析。 如塞克所讨论. 3.4,深度分解在深相阶段没有实现独立的KV分解,产生约三分之一的固定KV分解.
表3还报告了固定2K发电长度的9B MLA和16B GQA模型的端到端TTFT和TPOT。
深度加法大大地减少了TTFT,在预填量日益被计算得更长的上下文中,收益会更大.
在128K上下文长度上,TTFT在9B MLA上减少26.8%,在16B GQA上减少28.8%.
相比之下,TPOT几乎没有变化:在所有经过测试的背景长度中,间接费用仍然低于1%。
这表明"深度Graft"保持了解码效率,同时大幅减少了预填空档,而到理论加速的缺口可以通过专门的内核优化来被进一步缩小.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.3 阅读研究

blocks.en:
We conduct ablations on the 16B A3B MoE model to examine the roles of cross-layer gradient flow, connectivity pattern, and stage layout in DepthGraft.
We further compare DepthGraft with existing KV-sharing methods under the same training and evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh:
我们在16B A3B MOE模型上进行活化处理,以检查跨层梯度流,连接模式,和深角相位布局的作用.
我们还根据同一培训和评价协议,将深度分解法与现有的知识共享方法进行比较。

blocks.en:
Cross-layer gradients are the key source of the gain. Variants (2)–(4) all use the same three-stage layout, allowing us to isolate the effect of the cross-layer gradient path. Shallow-Copy directly reuses the stride-aligned shallow source from S 1 \text{S}_{1} , while Shallow-Copy (detach) stops gradients through the reused KV.
The detached variant does not degrade relative to the GQA baseline (42.86 vs. 42.38 Avg.), indicating redundancy in deep-layer KV.
Once the backward path is enabled, however, the average score increases markedly to 45.30.
This controlled comparison supports our central motivation: KV sharing is useful not only as a forward memory reuse mechanism, but also because cross-layer gradients regularize earlier KV representations through deep-layer training signals.
blocks.zh:
跨层梯度是收益的关键来源. 变体(2)-(4)都使用相同的三相布局,使我们能够隔离跨层梯度路径的效果. Shallow-Copy直接再用从S 1\text{S}_{1}得到的步态相通的浅源,而Shallow-Copy(detach)则通过再利用的KV停止梯度.
脱落变体相对于GQA基线(42.86 vs 42.38 Avg.)不降解,表明在深层KV中冗余.
然而,一旦向后路径启用,平均得分明显地增加到45.30分.
这种受控比较支持了我们的核心动机: KV共享不仅作为前置内存再利用机制有用,而且因为跨层梯度通过深层训练信号使更早的 KV 表示值规范化.

blocks.en:
Hierarchical reconstruction is more effective than single-source copy. Variants (3)–(5) compare single-source copy with hierarchical reconstruction under active cross-layer gradients. Shallow-Copy in Variant (3) only connects S 1 \text{S}_{1} to S 3 \text{S}_{3} , leaving the middle stage outside the sharing graph; the 2-stage variant (5) uses full one-to-one copy, but each reuse layer still receives only a single memory source.
DepthGraft instead reconstructs each deep-layer KV from a stride-aligned S 1 \text{S}_{1} – S 2 \text{S}_{2} source pair, improving the average score over both single-source alternatives (47.56 vs. 45.30 and 43.58).
The gains on representative benchmarks such as M-Pro, C3, C-Eval, and GSM8K suggest that the benefit comes from combining broad source participation with a more flexible hierarchical memory basis, rather than from cross-layer gradient flow alone.
blocks.zh:
分级重建比单源复制更有效. 变式(3)-(5)在活性的跨层梯度下将单源副本与分级重建进行比较. 变体(3)中的Shallow-Copy只连接了S 1\text{S}_{1}和S 3\text{S}_{3},使得共享图外的中间阶段离开;2相变体(5)使用完整的一对一复制,但每个再利用层仍然只接收到一个内存源.
DepthGraft转而从一个脚步相通的S 1\\text{S}_{1}-S 2\text{S}_{2}源对上重建出每个深层KV,比两个单源替代品(47.56对45.30和43.58)都提高了平均分.
M-Pro,C3,C-Eval,和GSM8K等代表性基准的增益表明,好处来自将广泛的源入参与与更灵活的分级记忆基础相结合,而不是单从跨层梯度流.

blocks.en:
The three-stage layout gives the best overall trade-off. Variants (5)–(8) compare different stage partitions under full gradient flow.
The reconstructed layers take stride-aligned sources and obtain their KV by either direct copy or hierarchical reconstruction.
The 2-stage variant is too restrictive, while the 4-stage variants test whether using more source stages or more reuse stages is beneficial.
The results suggest that reconstruction sources are not simply “the more the better”: reconstructing the last stage from three source stages underperforms the proposed two-source DepthGraft layout, and the 4-stage two-source variant also remains below the three-stage design.
Thus, a three-stage partition provides a stronger operating point, balancing two complementary source abstraction levels, distributed gradient flow, and the intended final-stage cache-saving region.
blocks.zh:

重建的地层取出步调相通的来源,通过直接复制或分级重建获得其KV.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 5 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en:
We presented DepthGraft, a hierarchical cross-layer KV reconstruction method that turns KV sharing from a cache-saving mechanism into a regularized memory pathway.
Our analysis shows that KV reuse creates direct cross-layer gradient paths that reshape KV representation geometry, and that the effectiveness of this regularization depends on the topology of the sharing graph.
Motivated by this view, DepthGraft reconstructs deep-layer KV from stride-aligned shallow–middle source pairs, preserving the efficiency benefits of KV sharing while distributing non-local gradient flow across source layers.
Experiments on dense and MoE models from 0.5B to 16B show consistent downstream gains, substantial reductions in KV cache and prefill cost, and negligible overhead during decoding.
Future work can develop a more rigorous theoretical understanding of how cross-layer KV sharing improves representation geometry, explore more effective sharing topologies, and further scale this direction to larger pretraining regimes.

我们的分析表明,KV再利用创造了直接的跨层梯度路径来重塑KV代表几何,这种正态化的有效性取决于共享图的地貌.
受此观点所驱使,深度外观从步态相通的浅-中源对重建了深层KV,保留了KV共享的效率效益,同时将非局部梯度流分布到源层.
对从0.5B到16B的密度模型和MOE模型进行的实验显示,下游收益一致,KV缓存和预填成本大幅降低,解码过程中的间接费用可忽略不计。
未来的工作可以更严格地从理论上理解跨层KV共享如何改善代表几何,探索更有效的共享地貌,并进一步将这一方向扩展到更大的预训制度.

Training hyperparameters. All comparisons at the same model scale use identical training recipes and token budgets, so that differences can be attributed to the KV-sharing design rather than optimization settings.
For the prior KV-sharing baselines in Table 5 , CLA/MLKV use three-layer sharing groups, while YOCO and FusedKV start reusing KV after the middle stage, i.e., after the first 2 ​ L / 3 2L/3 layers, as illustrated in Fig. 3 (b).
This matches the reuse ratio of DepthGraft for YOCO and FusedKV, allowing us to compare performance under different connectivity patterns.
For our 28-layer models, we leave layer 0 unshared and apply the three-stage reconstruction to the remaining 27 layers, resulting in three 9-layer stages.
We use AdamW with β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}{=}0.9 , β 2 = 0.95 \beta_{2}{=}0.95 , weight decay 0.1, and gradient clipping at 1.0.
Models smaller than 16B use a warmup–stable–decay schedule [ 36 ] : the final 20% of training tokens use exponential decay to reduce the learning rate to 0.1 of its peak value.
For the 16B MoE model, we use a warmup–stable schedule without LR decay and with batch-size ramp-up.
All models use the qwen2 tokenizer with a vocabulary size of 152,064 and are trained with a context length of 8192.
Our pretraining corpus is primarily proprietary and private, built from web text, code, math, and multilingual sources, with exact/fuzzy deduplication, rule-based filtering, and LLM-based quality filtering.

Interpretation and scope. The proposition is conditional: it does not claim that effective rank must change monotonically under arbitrary training dynamics.
It states that the K/V effective-rank trends follow when the induced update covariance is organized as suggested by the attention mechanism: keys receive coherent reinforcement in shared retrieval directions, while values receive complementary content gradients.
The topology of the sharing graph affects whether these assumptions are plausible.
Adjacent sharing may make 𝐐 s ≈ 𝐐 ℓ \mathbf{Q}_{s}\approx\mathbf{Q}_{\ell} and 𝐏 s ≈ 𝐏 ℓ \mathbf{P}_{s}\approx\mathbf{P}_{\ell} , yielding mostly redundant gradients.
Global-anchor sharing can overload a few sources with many heterogeneous objectives.
Stride-aligned non-local sharing is more likely to satisfy the assumptions because it provides sufficient cross-layer distance while distributing the gradient load across source layers.

Sec. 3.3 argues that global-anchor sharing, such as FusedKV, induces structurally uneven regularization: only the designated anchor layers participate in cross-layer gradient flow, while nearby non-anchor layers receive no direct gradient benefit from KV reuse.
We provide per-layer empirical evidence for this effect by tracking the value effective rank erank ⁡ ( 𝐕 ℓ ) \operatorname{erank}(\mathbf{V}_{\ell}) , defined in Eq. 5 , at individual layers throughout training.

This supports the topology analysis in Sec. 3.3 : global-anchor sharing confines the representation benefit to a small set of source layers.

blocks.en: E.2 Attention Sink Analysis
blocks.zh: E.2 注意沉积分析

blocks.en:
A common pathology in deep Transformers is the attention sink phenomenon, where a disproportionate amount of attention mass is assigned to the first token regardless of its semantic relevance [ 39 ] .
In our setting, this behavior provides an additional diagnostic of key geometry: if a layer develops extreme key directions, the softmax distribution can become dominated by a small number of sink positions.
blocks.zh:
在"深变形"中常见的病理是注意力沉积现象,其中不相称量的注意力质量被分配到第一个符号上,而不论其语义相关性[39].
在我们的设定中,这个行为为关键几何提供了额外的诊断:如果一个层发展出极端的关键方向,软马克斯分布可以被少量的下沉位置所支配.

blocks.en:
DepthGraft mitigates this tendency through cross-layer gradient regularization.
Each shallow or middle source serves its own attention layer while also being reused by a stride-aligned deep layer, so its KV projections receive optimization signals from multiple query spaces.
This structure can regularize the source key geometry and make it less likely for a layer to develop sink-prone key directions that dominate the softmax.
This is consistent with the analysis in Sec. 3.2 , where useful cross-layer KV sharing makes keys form a more compact retrieval geometry.
blocks.zh:
通过跨层梯度规范化来缓解这一趋势.
每个浅源或中源都服务于自己的关注层,同时被一个步态相通的深层再利用,因此其KV预测接收来自多个查询空间的优化信号.
这种结构可以使源密钥几何规范化,并让一地层更不可能开发出能支配软马克斯的可下沉的可下沉键取向.
这与Sec. 3.2中的分析一致,有用的跨层 KV 共享使得密钥形成更紧凑的检索几何.

blocks.en:
We verify this empirically by tracking the average attention score assigned to the first token throughout training.
Figure 6 reports this metric for both 9B GQA and 9B MLA models.
In both cases, DepthGraft consistently lowers first-token attention concentration relative to the baseline, indicating reduced attention-sink behavior.

图6报告了9B GQA和9B MLA模型的这一衡量标准。
在这两种情况下,深度引力始终比基线降低先入为主的注意力集中度,表明注意力相沉行为减少.

blocks.en:
Figure 7 compares the training loss curves of DepthGraft and the corresponding baselines across representative dense and MoE settings.
DepthGraft consistently achieves lower training loss across model scales and attention variants, indicating that the proposed cross-layer KV reconstruction does not introduce optimization instability.
The magnitude of the loss improvement, however, is moderate: the relative loss reduction is roughly 0.5 % 0.5\% .
blocks.zh:
图7比较了DepthGraft的训练损失曲线和具有代表性的密集和教育部设置的相应基线。
DepthGraft在模型尺度和关注变体之间持续地实现较低的培训损失,表明拟议的跨层KV重建不会带来优化不稳定.
然而,损失改善的程度是中等的:相对损失减少约为0.5%.5%.5%.。

blocks.en:
This behavior is consistent with the role of DepthGraft as a structural regularizer.
Unlike cross-layer designs whose primary effect is to substantially alter the residual computation pathway, DepthGraft constrains only the KV memory pathway and even removes independent deep-layer KV projections.
Consequently, its training-loss advantage is not as large as that reported for some broader cross-layer connectivity mechanisms, but it yields much larger downstream gains than the loss difference alone would suggest.
This supports our interpretation that DepthGraft improves the geometry and generalization of KV representations, rather than merely optimizing the pretraining loss more aggressively.
blocks.zh:
这种行为与"深度外观"作为结构调节器的作用是一致的.
与主要作用是实质性地改变剩余计算路径的跨层设计不同,深度Graft仅会约束KV内存路径,甚至会去除独立的深层KV预测.
因此,其培训-损失优势不如一些更广泛的跨层连通机制所报告的那样大,但其下游收益远大于损失差异。
这支持我们的解释,即深度分析改进了KV表示的几何和概括,而不是仅仅更积极地优化预训损失。

blocks.en: E.4 Reconstruction Coefficient Dynamics
blocks.zh: E.4 重建增效动力

blocks.en:
We further inspect the learned channel-wise reconstruction coefficients.
For each reused layer, DepthGraft reconstructs deep-layer KV from a shallow source (src1) and a middle source (src2).
Table 11 reports the final coefficient norm normalized by its initialization norm; values larger than 1 indicate that the corresponding source receives increased weight during training.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步检查了解的频道重建系数。
对于每个再利用的地层,深度重排从浅源(src1)和中源(src2)重建出深层KV.
表11报告最终系数规范按照其初始化规范正常化;大于1的数值表明,在培训期间相应来源的权重增加。

blocks.en:
The learned coefficients reveal a consistent K/V asymmetry.
For keys, the middle source is generally upweighted relative to the shallow source, suggesting that deep-layer retrieval benefits more from the more abstract middle-stage key geometry.
For values, the shallow source is more strongly upweighted, indicating that lower-level content features remain useful when reconstructing the deep-layer memory content.
This qualitative pattern is consistent with the observation behind FusedKV.
However, the comparison in Table 5 shows that FusedKV still underperforms DepthGraft under the same 16B A3B MoE setting.
This indicates that the benefit does not come only from two-source reconstruction; distributing the source–reuse connections across layers, and thereby spreading the cross-layer gradient regularization over many participating source layers, is also important.
blocks.zh:
所学的系数揭示出一致的K/V不对称.
对于密钥,相较于浅源,中源一般被提升,说明深层取取更能从更抽象的中相密钥几何学中受益.
对于值来说,浅层源被更强烈地提升,表明下层内容特征在重建深层内存内容时仍然有用.
这种质量模式与FusedKV背后的观察是一致的.
然而,表5中的比较表明,FusedKV在相同的16B A3B MoE设置下仍然表现不佳.
这表明,好处不仅仅来自两源重建;将源-再利用连接分层分配,从而将跨层梯度规范化扩展到许多参与源层也很重要。

blocks.en: Appendix F Efficiency and System Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录F 效率和系统分析

blocks.en: F.1 KV Cache and Prefill Cost
blocks.zh: F.1 KV 缓存和预填费用

blocks.en:
DepthGraft partitions the network into shallow, middle, and deep stages of approximately equal depth.
The shallow and middle stages materialize KV normally, while the deep stage reconstructs its KV from stride-aligned shallow–middle sources.
Therefore, no independent KV cache needs to be stored for the deep stage.
For an L L -layer model with identical KV dimensionality across layers, the baseline stores KV for all L L layers, whereas DepthGraft stores KV only for roughly 2 ​ L / 3 2L/3 source layers: KVCache D ​ e ​ p ​ t ​ h ​ G ​ r ​ a ​ f ​ t KVCache baseline ≈ 2 ​ L / 3 L = 2 3 . \frac{\mathrm{KVCache}_{DepthGraft{}}}{\mathrm{KVCache}_{\mathrm{baseline}}}\approx\frac{2L/3}{L}=\frac{2}{3}. (33) This gives an approximately one-third reduction in KV-cache memory during inference.
blocks.zh:
深度分出网络进入浅,中,深相相相近等深.
浅相和中相通常会实现KV,而深相则从相接的浅相-中相源重建其KV.
因此,不需要为深相级存储独立的KV缓存.
对于一个跨层具有相同KV维度的L-层模型,基线存储了所有LL层的KV,而深度Graft仅存储了大约2L / 3 2L/3源层的KV: KVCache D e pt h G r a fVCache 基线 → 2 L / 3 L = 2 3.\frac\ mathrm{KVCache\ 深度Graft\ mathrm{ KVCache\ mathrm{ 基线 → 近似\ frac{2L/3}L}=\Frac{2} 。 (33) 这使KV-cache内存在推论中减少约三分之一.

blocks.en:
The same structure also enables prefill early completion.
In standard autoregressive inference, the prefill phase processes the full prompt through all layers to produce the KV cache and the hidden state needed to generate the first response token.
In DepthGraft, the purpose of prefill with respect to KV construction is completed once the shallow and middle stages have processed the full prompt, because all KV tensors needed by future decoding steps have already been materialized.
The deep stage does not need to process the entire prompt to create additional KV cache.
Instead, after the shallow and middle KV caches are available, we only forward the final prompt token through the deep stage, using the stored shallow–middle KV caches to compute attention and produce the first response token.
blocks.zh:
同样的结构也使得可以提前填满.
在标准的自递性推论中,预填相会通过所有地层处理出出出KV缓存的全部快取和生成第一个响应符所需要隐藏的状态.
在 " 深度分解 " 中,一旦浅和中相阶段处理完全部快件,KV建造的预填目的即告完成,因为未来解码步骤所需的所有KV分解器都已经实现。
深相阶段不需要处理整个快取来创建额外的KV缓存.
相反,在浅而中 KV 缓存可用后,我们只通过深层的阶段转发最后的即时信号,使用所储存的浅而中 KV 缓存来计算注意力并产生第一个响应信号.

blocks.en:
Thus, the prefill saving comes from avoiding full-sequence computation in the deep stage, while retaining the necessary computation for the last prompt token that initializes decoding.
As context length and model size increase, the full-prompt prefill computation becomes increasingly dominant, and the cost of forwarding only the final token through the deep stage becomes a smaller fraction of total prefill cost.
This explains the trend in Table 3 : the measured TTFT reduction grows at longer context lengths and approaches the theoretical one-third saving.
blocks.zh:
因此,填充预存来自于在深层阶段避免了全序计算,同时保留了对初始化解码的最后一个快取符的必要计算.
随着上下文长度和模型大小的增大,全速预填计算越来越占主导地位,通过深层相接阶段仅转发最终令牌的成本会成为预填总成本的一小部分.
这解释了表3中的趋势:测量到的TTFT减幅在较长的上下文长度上增长,接近理论上的三分之一节能.

blocks.en: F.2 Training FLOPs and Parameter Count
blocks.zh: F.2 培训FLOP和参数计数

blocks.en:
DepthGraft does not introduce additional training FLOPs in the way that many explicit cross-layer connectivity mechanisms do.
The shallow and middle stages are computed normally, and the deep-stage KV reconstruction only requires element-wise linear combinations of two cached source tensors.
This mixing cost is negligible compared with the matrix multiplications in attention and FFN layers.
Moreover, because the deep stage does not require independent K/V projections, an implementation can skip the corresponding K/V projection computation in reused layers, slightly reducing training FLOPs.
In our large-scale runs, the observed training throughput is essentially identical to the baseline.

这种混合成本与注意层和FFN层的矩阵乘法相比微不足道.
此外,由于深相阶段不需要独立的克/克预测,一个执行可以跳过相应的克/克预测在再利用层中的计算,略微减少训练FLOP.

blocks.en: F.3 Parallel Training Compatibility
blocks.zh: F.3 平行培训兼容性

blocks.en:
Pipeline parallelism (PP) is essential for training large Transformers whose parameters and activations cannot fit on a single device.
PP partitions the model along depth and assigns different layer blocks to different physical pipeline ranks.
Virtual pipeline parallelism (VPP) further splits each physical stage into smaller virtual chunks, typically at layer granularity, and interleaves their execution to reduce pipeline bubbles and improve hardware utilization.
For cross-layer KV sharing, the main systems concern is whether a reuse layer needs to fetch source KV tensors from a different PP rank; such accesses would introduce additional cross-stage communication and complicate activation lifetime management.

Because each deep layer reuses a stride-aligned shallow–middle source pair, the source and reuse layers can be co-located on the same physical PP rank under an appropriate VPP partition.

Using zero-based layer indices, the network is divided into three 12-layer stages: layers 0–11, 12–23, and 24–35.
Each deep layer i + 24 i+24 reconstructs KV from the stride-aligned pair ( i , i + 12 ) (i,i+12) , and each triple ( i , i + 12 , i + 24 ) (i,i+12,i+24) is placed on the same physical PP rank.
Thus, cross-layer KV production and consumption remain local to one device.

blocks.en:
This layout preserves the natural forward order as three repeated PP passes over shallow, middle, and deep depth bands, while keeping the non-local KV dependency local within each physical rank.
With layer-granular VPP chunks, no additional inter-rank KV transfer is required for DepthGraft under this placement.
In this balanced setting, every PP rank owns exactly three shallow layers, three middle layers, and three deep reuse layers, so the per-rank layer count is identical.
For practical model depths that are not perfectly divisible by the number of PP ranks, the placement may introduce mild imbalance, but the final load remains close.
This locality property is important for scaling DepthGraft to large distributed pretraining runs without changing the communication pattern of the baseline PP/VPP system.

带有分层 VPP块,在此放置下,深度Graft不需要额外的等级间KV转移.
在这种平衡的设置中,每个PP排名都拥有精确的3个浅层,3个中层,和3个深层再利用层,因此每个平分等级的分层计数相同.
对于不完全被PP排行数所分辨的实用型号深度,投放可能会引入轻微的不平衡,但最终负载仍然很接近.
这种地方属性对于在不改变基线PP/VPP系统的通信模式的情况下将深度Graft扩展至大规模分布式预训运行十分重要。
